categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Carries the 'Private Broadcast' label and directly addresses transaction origin privacy by altering how unconfirmed transactions are re-announced and served to peers.
categories.rationale: Fixes an origin privacy leak where nodes running `-privatebroadcast` serve dropped unconfirmed transactions to requesting peers over clearnet. Commit 6d5450244b highlights that a dropped transaction 'held by this node alone, and served to any peer that asks for it... marks it as the node's own.'

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Carries the 'Wallet' label and modifies `src/wallet/wallet.cpp` and `src/wallet/wallet.h` to suppress wallet rebroadcast and mempool resubmission.
categories.rationale: Prevents the wallet from undermining user privacy by automatically resubmitting dropped unconfirmed transactions when `-privatebroadcast` is active. The description notes this prevents scenarios where 'an incoming dust payment triggering your node to rebroadcast 24-36th later over clearnet' compromises wallet privacy.
